description: Called it a Saturday, not a fortune.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Counted the same pile, and went for the gate.
name: George Bryan

description: Told the share, and named Monday at two as The Shrew.
name: John Heminges

description: Asked after the Rose, and named Monday's bill again on the way out.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Asked to have his counted twice, and stayed on you.
name: Will Kemp

description: Took six-and-twenty into his purse, left the coffer shut, and named nine o'clock.
name: William Shakespeare
